tax.text: Scott voted for the 2025 One Big Beautiful Bill Act and described its tax reductions as historic relief for workers, families, farmers, and small businesses.
tax.quote: This legislation delivers historic tax relief for workers, middle-class families, farmers, and small businesses.

wages.text: Scott voted against the 2019 Raise the Wage Act.
wages.quote: Vote Question: On Passage Raise the Wage Act Vote Type: Recorded Vote Status: Passed

debt.text: Scott endorsed slowing Medicare spending growth and giving future beneficiaries subsidies to purchase approved private plans.
debt.quote: In the future, beneficiaries will receive a premium subsidy from the government to purchase a Medicare-approved health plan of their choice.

schools.text: Scott voted to reauthorize the District of Columbia's opportunity-scholarship program.
schools.quote: Voted YES on reauthorizing the DC opportunity scholarship program.

safety.text: Scott requested millions of dollars for law-enforcement training facilities, firearms equipment, police vehicles, and related public-safety infrastructure.
safety.quote: Provides a $3,827,990 investment for a Comprehensive Training Complex, designed to train law enforcement in high-intensity drills and stage multi-agency exercises.

immigration.text: Scott calls for securing the border, removing immigrants who are in the country illegally, and enforcing existing laws before other immigration reforms.
immigration.quote: We must first secure our borders, remove the illegal immigrants currently in our country and enforce our existing immigration laws before we attempt to implement any type of immigration reform.

guns.text: Scott opposes additional gun-control laws and says he will continue protecting the right to keep and bear arms.
guns.quote: I will continue to support and protect our rights afforded under the Second amendment which allows us to secure the safety of our homes and families.

abortion.text: Scott identifies as pro-life, says life begins at conception, and has supported and sponsored legislation restricting abortion and funding for abortion providers.
abortion.quote: I am proud to be pro-life and am committed to protecting the lives of the unborn.

gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: Scott cosponsored H.R. 28, which would base Title IX athletic eligibility solely on reproductive biology and genetics at birth.
gender.quote: To amend the Education Amendments of 1972 to provide that for purposes of determining compliance with title IX of such Act in athletics, sex shall be recognized based solely on a person’s reproductive biology and genetics at birth.

cannabis.text: Scott voted against the 2022 MORE Act, which would have federally descheduled and decriminalized cannabis.
cannabis.quote: Vote Question: On Passage MORE Act Vote Type: Yea-And-Nay Status: Passed

health.text: Scott supports market-based health reforms, voted to repeal the Affordable Care Act, and favors competition among approved insurance plans.
health.quote: The American people deserve common sense, market-based reforms that lower costs, increase access to more affordable care, and give citizens more control over their health care decisions.

energy.text: Scott supports affordable energy and increased domestic production of oil, natural gas, and coal.
energy.quote: We must develop an energy supply that is reliable, protected, and affordable.

voting.text: Scott supports identification requirements for mail ballots and opposes federal mandates for universal mail voting, ballot harvesting, and same-day registration.
voting.quote: They create more opportunities for Georgians to vote and better secure elections by requiring identification for mail-in ballots, just as you have to show an ID to vote in-person in Georgia.

tax.text: Esti said tax dollars should protect communities and opposed further tax cuts for businesses and individuals he said do not need them.
tax.quote: We must protect our communities with our tax dollars and not continue to provide tax cuts to businesses and individuals who don’t need them.

wages.text: Esti signed an agreement committing his campaign to a fair process for recognizing its workers’ union.
wages.quote: Campaigns for U.S. Congress, Governor, Lieutenant Governor, and State Congress across the nation have signed the Card Check Agreement and committed to a fair and prompt process to recognize their workers’ union.

trade.text: Esti opposes tariffs, describing them as barriers for small businesses and a tax on Americans.
trade.quote: protecting small businesses from unnecessary barriers like tariffs which is nothing but a tax on the American people

immigration.text: Esti supports immigration reform that includes a pathway to citizenship.
immigration.quote: immigration reform that includes a pathway to citizenship!

abortion.text: Esti said he is running to preserve and strengthen access to abortion.
abortion.quote: erosion of civil rights and basic freedoms like perserving & strengthening the right to vote & access to abortion

health.text: Esti supports strengthening federal health programs and funding rural clinics and hospitals.
health.quote: As your congressman, my role is to strengthen federal health programs, support funding for rural clinics and hospitals, and work with agencies to improve access to essential services throughout the district.

energy.text: Esti supports allowing communities to adopt renewable energy when it lowers their long-term costs.
energy.quote: As renewable energy, like solar and wind, becomes more affordable nationwide, communities should have the option to explore these alternatives if they believe they will reduce long‑term costs.

voting.text: Esti said he is running to preserve and strengthen the right to vote.
voting.quote: erosion of civil rights and basic freedoms like perserving & strengthening the right to vote & access to abortion
